title: PrismCrawl Bing Search API input
description: Run live Bing searches through the PrismCrawl API and receive normalized search results, SERP features, and pagination metadata. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

query.title: Search query
query.description: What to search for on Bing. Search operators such as site: work as usual. Limited to 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (one Bing results page each). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

cc.title: Country (cc)
cc.description: Two-letter Bing result-country code, from Bing's published country list.

setlang.title: Interface language (setlang)
setlang.description: Bing interface-language hint, such as en-US. It affects interface strings such as related-search labels; it does not restrict results to that language.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Searcher latitude. Bing uses it as a location signal to bias local relevance, not as a strict filter. Set together with longitude.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude, for example -76.6122. Set together with latitude.

device.title: Device
device.description: Search as a desktop, mobile, or tablet device.

tbs.title: Time range (tbs)
tbs.description: Time filter in Google-compatible syntax, translated to Bing's date filter: qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (past week), qdr:m (past month), qdr:y (past year), with an optional number such as qdr:m6; or a custom range cdr:1,cd_min:8/1/2026,cd_max:8/12/2026. Hour ranges are not supported.

safe.title: SafeSearch
safe.description: Bing Strict SafeSearch (active) or unfiltered results (off). Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
